Crime & Law · India

Jewelry and cash stolen in separate incidents; suspects captured on CCTV

In two separate incidents, jewelry and cash were stolen from a home in Karnal and a jewelry shop in Garhani. Police have registered cases based on complaints, with one incident showing suspects captured on CCTV footage. Investigations are ongoing.
